details.originalGui: Blank white window; WebKit content processes repeatedly terminated.
details.entitlementProbe: Same prebuilt binary re-signed with only com.apple.security.network.client added; UI and native backend handshake rendered. The probe artifact is not the original notarized artifact.
details.safeAudit: External Fastboot launch denied with Operation not permitted (os error 1); the original Promise.all discarded the complete report.
details.partialAuditFix: Now retains successful probes, reports unavailable probes explicitly, times out waiting after 12s and blocks readiness. ADB/MTP strict errors are retained. A timeout does not cancel the native read-only probe.
details.localTests: 269 tests across 37 files, TypeScript and frontend build passed with the recorded worktree file hashes.
details.installerCopySmoke: Remote Desktop Commander rejected the disk-image attach/copy command before execution. No command-policy bypass attempted.
details.deviceState: No external USB target appeared in the fresh host IORegistry scan. Android physical qualification remains blocked.
details.runtimeLimits: Intel Mac macOS 26.5.2; Apple Silicon execution not physically tested.
details.source: Tauri maintainer issue https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/13815 and Apple network.client entitlement documentation.
